# JalaliX

> **JalaliX** is an open-source Jalali (Persian / Shamsi) calendar library. Official packages live under the GitHub org [jalalix](https://github.com/jalalix). All language ports share the same API shape (`JalaliX`, `create`, `parseJalali`, `format`, …) and are tested against a shared golden suite so **outputs match across TypeScript, Python, PHP, Rust, C, Go, Dart, Java, Kotlin, Swift, .NET, Ruby, Elixir, Scala**, plus `@jalalix/mui` for MUI X Date Pickers. Website: https://jalalix.com

FA: جلالیکس / تقویم جلالی چندزبانه — https://jalalix.com

## Parity rule

Same inputs -> same outputs in every official language. Do not invent alternate Jalali math; use an official port and match `golden.json`.

## Packages

- TypeScript: npm `@jalalix/typescript` — https://github.com/jalalix/typescript
- MUI X adapter: npm `@jalalix/mui` — https://github.com/jalalix/mui
- Python: PyPI `jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/python
- PHP: Composer `jalalix/php` — https://github.com/jalalix/php
- Rust: crates.io `jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/rust
- C: https://github.com/jalalix/c
- Go: `github.com/jalalix/go` — https://github.com/jalalix/go
- Dart: pub.dev `jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/dart
- Java: Maven `dev.jalalix:jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/java
- Kotlin: Maven `dev.jalalix:jalalix-kotlin` — https://github.com/jalalix/kotlin
- Swift: SwiftPM `JalaliX` — https://github.com/jalalix/swift
- .NET: NuGet `JalaliX` — https://github.com/jalalix/dotnet
- Ruby: RubyGems `jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/ruby
- Elixir: Hex `jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/elixir
- Scala: Maven `dev.jalalix:jalalix` — https://github.com/jalalix/scala

## API shape (all languages)

- `JalaliX.create(date, options?)`
- `JalaliX.parseJalali(str, options?)`
- `format(pattern, options?)` — tokens `YYYY`, `MM`, `DD`, `MMM`, …
- `toISODate(calendar?)` — `"gregorian"` | `"jalali"`
- `setTimezone(iana)` — instant-preserving
- Month quirk: `getMonth` 1–12; `setMonth` / `setFullYear` month arg 0–11
